result.question: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior queda absoluta de internações entre os períodos 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?
result.gold_sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n1 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n2 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", p1.n1 AS periodo_2008_2012, p2.n2 AS periodo_2019_2023, (p1.n1 - p2.n2) AS queda_absoluta FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = p2."DIAG_PRINC" JOIN cid c ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE p1.n1 > 1000 ORDER BY queda_absoluta DESC LIMIT 10;
result.generated_sql: WITH internacoes_2008_2012 AS ( SELECT i."DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 GROUP BY i."DIAG_PRINC" ), internacoes_2019_2023 AS ( SELECT i."DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 GROUP BY i."DIAG_PRINC" ) SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, COALESCE(i2012.total_internacoes, 0) - COALESCE(i2023.total_internacoes, 0) AS delta_temporal FROM internacoes_2008_2012 i2012 FULL OUTER JOIN internacoes_2019_2023 i2023 ON i2012."DIAG_PRINC" = i2023."DIAG_PRINC" JOIN cid c ON COALESCE(i2012."DIAG_PRINC", i2023."DIAG_PRINC") = c."CID" ORDER BY delta_temporal DESC LIMIT 10;
